steps.name: sync-exact-head
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin main; git checkout -B main origin/main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "d4f73bef621a198d384d5ba9ff3e1a775c3aa57a"; test -f app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

steps.name: recover-wireless-s22
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; adb start-server >/dev/null; echo '--- mdns ---'; adb mdns services || true; for E in $(adb mdns services 2>/dev/null | awk '/_adb-tls-connect\._tcp/ {print $NF}'); do adb connect "$E" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; sleep 2; echo '--- devices ---'; adb devices -l; SEL=''; for D in $(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); do case "$D" in *:*) M="$(adb -s "$D" shell getprop ro.product.model 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"; S="$(adb -s "$D" shell getprop ro.serialno 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')"; if [ "$M" = SM-S906B ] && [ "$S" = RFCT70L7E8J ]; then SEL="$D"; break; fi;; esac; done; test -n "$SEL" || { echo 'verified_wireless_s22_not_found=true' >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s' "$SEL" >/tmp/aicall-wireless-selector; echo 'verified_wireless_s22=true'

steps.name: nonstreaming-install
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; SEL="$(cat /tmp/aicall-wireless-selector)"; APK="app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk"; adb -s "$SEL" install --no-streaming -r "$APK"; echo 'apk_installed=true'

steps.name: launch-and-inspect
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; SEL="$(cat /tmp/aicall-wireless-selector)"; adb -s "$SEL" shell am force-stop pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; adb -s "$SEL" shell monkey -p pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge 1 >/dev/null; sleep 2; OUT="$(adb -s "$SEL" shell dumpsys package pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge)"; echo 'app_launched=true'; for P in android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO android.permission.CALL_PHONE android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE android.permission.ANSWER_PHONE_CALLS; do echo "$OUT" | grep -E "$P: granted=(true|false)" | head -1 || true; done
